longTitle.officialTitle: To direct the Secretary of the Interior to convey to the City of Eunice, Louisiana, certain Federal land in Louisiana, and for other purposes.

main.enactingFormula: Be it enacted by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled,

section.heading: SHORT TITLE.
section.content: This Act may be cited as the “Save the Liberty Theatre Act of 2021”.

paragraph.heading: City.—
paragraph.content: The term “City” means the City of Eunice, Louisiana.

paragraph.heading: Map.—
paragraph.content: The term “map” means the map entitled “Jean Lafitte National Historical Park and Preserve, Proposed Boundary Revision and Disposal”, numbered 467/168813, and dated December 2020.

paragraph.heading: Secretary.—
paragraph.content: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of the Interior.

subsection.heading: Conveyance Authority.—
subsection.content: The Secretary shall convey to the City, by quitclaim deed and without consideration, all right, title, and interest of the United States in and to the parcels of land described in subsection (b).

subsection.heading: Description of Land.—
subsection.content: The parcels of land referred to in subsection (a) are Lots 5 and 6, less the North 27 feet of Lot 5, Block 22, of the Original Townsite of Eunice, generally depicted as “Proposed Disposal Area” on the map.

subsection.heading: Availability of Map.—
subsection.content: The map shall be on file and available for public inspection in the appropriate offices of the National Park Service.

section.heading: BOUNDARY ADJUSTMENTS.
section.chapeau: Upon the conveyance to the City of the land described in section 3(b), the boundary of the Jean Lafitte National Historical Park and Preserve shall be adjusted to exclude—

paragraph.content: Lots 7 and 8 of the Original Townsite of Eunice generally depicted as “Non-NPS in Current Boundary” on the map.
